answer_2.quote: We primarily focus on two evaluation metrics: (1) Defense Success Rate (DSR), which refers to the percentage of cases in which an LLM follows exactly the above defense goal, and (2) Follow-up Defense Success Rate (FDSR) that captures the percentage of cases where the LLM continued to comply after receiving follow-up query attempts to bypass a defense policy.
